source_snapshot.procedure: Run local raw 0x2c 0x0a 0xdc 0 0x10 <Data>; source says to copy getter data and change one byte.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL with operator-supplied MC_ID_STRING and read-back, but it uses an insecure remote SSH wrapper and wrongly labels the identity write as power/thermal configuration.

historical_reviews.deepseek: It correctly gates the mutation, but its convenience command does not prove raw encoding or a reversible identity lifecycle.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly keeps the identifiable operation prerequisite-driven and strengthens the unsafe source parameter instruction.
historical_reviews.history: The invalidated prior-run location was found but excluded as authority; both getter variants were checked only to define baseline/read-back evidence.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Identity metadata must never be corrupted merely to demonstrate that a setter accepts bytes.

original_test_intent: Set one approved management-controller identifier through the local DCMI path, verify exact storage and consumers, and restore the original identity when the test plan requires it.
original_method: Preserve raw 0x2c 0x0a 0xdc and local execution, but replace arbitrary byte mutation with one exact owner-approved encoded identifier based on a complete baseline and documented request layout.
manual_activity: The asset/BMC owner supplies and approves the exact replacement identifier, encoding, length, persistence, affected consumers, maintenance window and byte-exact restore value.
required_inputs: Exact replacement string and encoded payload
Allowed character set, length and padding
safety_requirements: Do not mutate an arbitrary byte
Prevent inventory or provisioning from trusting temporary identity
Read back all bytes and consumers
agent_execution_scope: Validate exact encoded replacement and restoration
Check inventory consumers and persistence boundary
engineer_actions: Approve exact string, scope, consumers and recovery
Own final PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level setter may supplement execution only after equivalence is proven; its SSH route is not the named local method and a generic string does not document raw length/offset bytes.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After complete baseline and approval, issue one local raw 0x2c 0x0a 0xdc 0 0x10 <approved-encoded-data>, then reconstruct exact read-back and restore the original under the plan.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source opcode, local route and 10/5 timing are retained; the unsafe arbitrary-byte choice is explicitly gated rather than silently executed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the identifier as governed asset metadata: validate a sanctioned value, capture every consumer, perform one byte-defined write, prove complete read-back/persistence and restore before dependent systems act on it.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random corruption with an approved reversible identity transaction and semantic consumer checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command completion and a partial getter fragment do not prove the intended full string or its effect on inventory/provisioning.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Invalid or temporary identity data can split asset records, misroute service actions or undermine operator trust even when management access remains functional.

project_override_considerations: A vendor CLI is acceptable only with documented raw equivalence, complete byte evidence and the same consumer/restore checks; otherwise raw setter coverage remains unproven.
expected_evidence: Exact encoded set request/response and completion

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master title, 0x0a setter and instruction to alter the identifier all point to the same write operation. The arbitrary-byte method and success-only criterion are unsafe and inadequate, but not mutually contradictory source statements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The identity-write purpose is clear. Exact string, encoding, baseline, approval and recovery are identifiable prerequisites, so this remains REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION.

review_improvement: Prevents deliberate identity corruption and defines an approved, byte-complete, consumer-aware and reversible controller-metadata write.
independent_technical_reasoning: A setter test needs a meaningful valid value, not merely a changed byte. Because the identifier can be consumed outside DCMI, the transaction must control both encoding and downstream visibility. Complete baseline/read-back plus restoration proves setter behavior without leaving the platform in a misleading identity state.
